messages.subject: Stan meetup at Google NYC on Tuesday 5:30 pm. Registration closes tomorrow morning.
parts:
Hi all,

Krzysztof Sakrejda is giving a cool talk on a survival model for Dengue infection using Stan. If you're interested, please register asap. Google is asking for the names for security by tomorrow morning. 

https://www.meetup.com/bda-group/events/237256351/

See you there!


Daniel
